definition: A public display of works of art or items of interest.
exampleSentence: Thousands of visitors attended the impressionist art exhibition.

definition: Property that is or may be inherited; valued objects and qualities such as historic buildings.
exampleSentence: The medieval fortress is protected as an official world heritage site.

definition: A work of outstanding artistry, skill, or workmanship.
exampleSentence: The ceiling of the chapel is considered an undisputed masterpiece.

definition: The art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms.
exampleSentence: The museum gardens feature several bronze sculptures by Henry Moore.

definition: A person who writes music, especially as a professional occupation.
exampleSentence: The symphony was written by an eighteenth-century classical composer.
